rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an exchange of two comparable things.

example.english: This swap was fair; nobody lost out.
example.traditional: 呢次交換好公平，大家都冇蝕底。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 gaau1 wun6 hou2 gung1 ping4 daai6 gaa1 dou1 mou5 sit6 dai2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for giving or exchanging one thing for another.

example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 nei5 wun6 wai2 co5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the exchange is explicitly mutual, such as exchanging gifts or contact details.

example.english: We did a swap of phone numbers so it would be easier to contact each other later.
example.traditional: 我哋交換咗電話號碼，方便之後聯絡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaau1 wun6 zo2 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 fong1 bin6 zi1 hau6 lyun4 lok3
